text:
alex: quick RFC follow-up — proposing a "chop-and-stitch" safety checklist before we start slicing services. want to capture all the edge cases we hit last time.

alex: TL;DR: migration-only shims, kv ownership handoff, prefix-caching guarantees, client compatibility, canary & rollback playbook, observability smoke tests.

maria: +1. can we list concrete safety cases? i'm worried about stateful requests that touch both old and new slice.

sam: first pass: 1) read-after-write consistency when tenant requests straddle old+new, 2) backpressure semantics during partial deploy, 3) error translation (5xx->structured error).

jen: also add: 4) identity/tenant header passthrough on the stitch proxy, 5) KV cache warmup + eviction race checks.

priyanka: for kv handoff we should enforce a 'dual-write' window with a deterministic rollback marker. that helped during the session-mesh extract.

alex: dual-write window sounds right. need a short-lived schema that both sides accept. how do we detect drift? what metrics?

maria: metric set: cross-service write latency, duplicate-write counts, cache-miss delta vs baseline, #requests that hit both endpoints. add a 'hunk-id' header for tracing.

sam: devex: can we get automatic tracing by adding a small shim that injects hunk-id and logs a small JSON blob? infra-bot can create a sampling rule.

infra-bot: created rule "chop-stitch-sample" at 1% for traces with header hunk-id. rule id: cs-2026-01.

jen: rollback playbook idea: feature flag + canary -> if duplicate-write ratio > 0.1% for 5m or error-rate increases 2x, flip flag, route 100% to old slice. document runbook steps.

priyanka: we should also include a data-replay test: a script to replay recent 24h events against the new slice in read-only mode. if outputs differ beyond threshold, block rollout.

alex: good. can someone draft the checklist as a PR in the arch repo? include minimal test commands and the rollback matrix.

maria: i'll start the PR with checklist + metrics dashboard template. will add sample query for "cross_endpoint_hits" and alert thresholds.

sam: devex, mind pairing on the replay script? i can sketch a PoC.

devex: yep — i'll add a README snippet and a tiny helper that normalizes timestamps. put it under infra/tools/replay. keep it idempotent.

jen: one more: contract compatibility. if we change a proto, add a compatibility shim that translates v2->v1 and vice versa for 48h. no clients should break.

priyanka: note on performance: the stitch proxy adds ~1-2ms p50. include perf budget in the rollout gating. if p95 increases >10% abort.

alex: great — consensus. action items: maria PR checklist, sam+devex replay PoC, priyanka kv dual-write plan, jen rollback doc, infra-bot will wire the trace sampling. i'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow to review PR.

maria: thanks — tagging @eng-sre for the alert thresholds.

sam: draft PR link when ready and i'll review.

alex: thanks team. short thread — let’s keep this lightweight but prescriptive. :thumbsup:
